mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (from_user_id, to_user_id, content, is_read) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, #{isRead})
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, u.nickname as to_user_nickname, u.avatar as to_user_avatar FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.to_user_id = u.id WHERE m.from_user_id = #{fromUserId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
SELECT m.*, u.nickname as from_user_nickname, u.avatar as from_user_avatar FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.from_user_id = u.id WHERE m.to_user_id = #{toUserId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

SELECT m.*, u1.nickname as from_user_nickname, u1.avatar as from_user_avatar, u2.nickname as to_user_nickname, u2.avatar as to_user_avatar FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u1 ON m.from_user_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON m.to_user_id = u2.id WHERE (m.from_user_id = #{userId1} AND m.to_user_id = #{userId2}) OR (m.from_user_id = #{userId2} AND m.to_user_id = #{userId1}) ORDER BY m.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE to_user_id = #{toUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, u.nickname as from_user_nickname, u.avatar as from_user_avatar FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON (CASE WHEN m.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN m.to_user_id ELSE m.from_user_id END) = u.id WHERE m.id IN ( SELECT MAX(m2.id) FROM message m2 WHERE (m2.from_user_id = #{userId} OR m2.to_user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY CASE WHEN m2.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN m2.to_user_id ELSE m2.from_user_id END ) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
